question.problem:
Which of the following values of $t$ satisfy the inequality $7t\ge 19\,?$

I. $t=2$

II. $t=3$

III. $t=4$
question.worked_solution:
We substitute each value into the given inequality and check to see if the resulting statement is true or false.

- We substitute the value $t=2$ into the given inequality. We get:

$$
\begin{aligned}7t & \ge 19 \\ 7\cdot 2 & \ge 19 \\ 14 & \ge 19\,\times \end{aligned}
$$

So, substituting $t=2$ into the inequality leads to a **false** statement. 

Therefore, $t=2$ **does not satisfy** this inequality.

- We substitute the value $t=3$ into the given inequality. We get:

$$
\begin{aligned}7t & \ge 19 \\ 7\cdot 3 & \ge 19 \\ 21 & \ge 19\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

So, substituting $t=3$ into the inequality leads to a **true** statement. 

Therefore, $t=3$ **satisfies** this inequality.

- We substitute the value $t=4$ into the given inequality. We get:

$$
\begin{aligned}7t & \ge 19 \\ 7\cdot 4 & \ge 19 \\ 28 & \ge 19\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

So, substituting $t=4$ into the inequality leads to a **true** statement. 

Therefore, $t=4$ **satisfies** this inequality.
